title: FindReplaceNoteAgendaRequest
description: Request body for replacing a single occurrence of text in a note's agenda.

find.description: Existing agenda text to replace. Must appear exactly once, or the request is rejected.
find.title: Find

content_fellow_markdown.description: Fellow Markdown to substitute for the matched text, in the same format the note object's content_fellow_markdown field returns. An empty string deletes the matched text.
content_fellow_markdown.title: Content Fellow Markdown
